scientific_integrity: The proof uses the exact multivariate-normal conditional mean and covariance, a common-residual monotone coupling for sufficiency, coordinate marginal means for necessity, and the equal-variance normal likelihood-ratio formula. The bundled verifier only replays deterministic matrix identities and examples.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to positive-definite Gaussian vectors conditioned on their unweighted total. It resolves the Gaussian multivariate-vector subproblem but not the motivating paper's full non-Gaussian extension question. Older Gaussian comparison literature could contain an equivalent equal-covariance location-family statement under different terminology.
title: Exact row-sum criterion for Gaussian vectors conditioned on their total
